item.title: Etsy bans AI-generated recipes and patterns from its online marketplace

item.title: Trump asked Musk to lift Starlink slowdown, WSJ reports
item.description: Elon Musk, a critic of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, had ordered the slowdown of SpaceX's Starlink, The Wall Street Journal previously reported.

item.title: Reported fraud losses among older Americans hit $3 billion in 2025 as big losses surge: FTC report
item.description: Older Americans reported $2.1 billion in fraud losses of at least $100,000, accounting for 70% of the $3 billion lost overall, according to the FTC.

item.title: SK Hynix shares jump over 4% after early losses as chipmaker scraps Solidigm IPO plans
item.description: SK Hynix shares closed 4% higher after an initial drop in early trading as the chipmaker halted review of Solidigm IPO plans in the U.S.

item.title: Japan core inflation in September surges to its highest this year at 2.1%
